highestPriorityNextRead: Resolve the held ark introductory source (Gen 6) and explicit Exodus firstborn passage (Ex 12:29–30) without rewriting the authors.
Apply a narrow Catholic literary readthrough of John 19:38–42 before the John 20 sepulchre, using only real text and separate source status.
Check Acts 28:16–22 before 28:23–31 (Rome audience's appointment), without pretending Paul's entire itinerary is included.
Review the genre boundary between Acts history and Apocalypse 1/4/5: it is a visionary literary transition, not a scene on a historical map.
Do an independent witnessed, read-aloud pass in each chosen publication language across every transition; no approval has been granted.
Do not trim 1,500-word covenant/prophetic chapters solely to normalize duration; trial abridgment must be source-only and meaning-preserving.
